Name: Nekrolina Cat Replacer
Author: Kuradjinou
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45627/45627-1777562676-921923704.png[/img]
Replaces the black cat in Stardew Valley with Nekrolina. If you don't know who Nekrolina is, she's a sweet and silly catgirl Vtuber who[url=https://www.twitch.tv/nekrolina] streams on Twitch[/url]. She mostly chats and reacts to memes and videos, and occasionally sings or plays a casual game.

[size=4][b]﻿INSTALLATION:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]    -Download and install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ if you haven't already.
    (It will also require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url])

    -Download the mod.

    -Unzip the NekrolinaCat zip file. Choose either the Tail version folder or No tail version folder.
   
    -Place the unzipped folder ( [CP] NekrolinaCat ) into the Mods folder (e.g. C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)

    -Start the game using SMAPI (StardewModdingAPI.exe in the Stardew Valley folder).

    -Play the game![/spoiler]


Last functionality test was on Stardew Valley v1.6.15.
If you have any troubles with the mod, leave a comment and I'll try to get back to you when I can.
-Kuradjinou
